# Matchboard Copilot bootstrap

Start with the repository root `AGENTS.md` and then read the relevant module(s) in `docs/agents/README.md` before planning or editing code.

Do not add `@` imports of large documents back into auto-loaded instruction files. Keep the bootstrap small and rely on the modular reference set under `docs/agents/` for detailed product, domain, and security guidance.

Matchboard-specific rules remain canonical in:

- `features/matchboard.feature`
- `docs/development/coding-agent-working-session.md`
- `SECURITY.md`
- `docs/adr/` and `docs/arr/`

When the task affects product behavior, UX, security, or schema, update the matching docs together and maintain alignment before completion.
